findings.issue: Contract dependencies lists this story, RWB-P10-E2028-CON, as its own dependency, with a stray 'C' prefix.
In the Answer element and Record mapping rows, content from GAP-0623, GAP-0622 and GAP-1294 sits in the new BR Field ID column.
Section 11 still gives the AgentRunCompleted payload as 'run facts of agent_run', not the catalogue fields now in 12.3.
Section 11 compares data_as_of with the case record data date, but the freshness row still says dataAsOf is compared with the freshness business date.
The freshness row still calls the path 'GET /freshness ... on the service base', which no longer matches /data-products/freshness.
BR13 and BR14 were added to section 8, but AC9 and the section 16 covers stop at BR12, leaving two rules untraced.
The disposition note says no section 7 criterion was added, but AC9 now traces the business rules there.
